C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS.Architecture: In each shared component stylesheet add its named focus-visible selector with outline: 2px solid var(--prefAccent) and outline-offset: 1px, matching the existing Quick Settings tab/open-all treatment. Keep the component template and JavaScript byte-identical except semantic contract/change-summary comments. No consumer-local focus styles, palette changes, new tokens, wrappers, tabindex, listeners, dependencies or preference writes. The ordinary selected/on/nearest-preset styling remains responsible for value state; the additional outline identifies only the keyboard target.
C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS.RegressionDesign: Append two theme-parameterized consumer tests to settings-shell.spec.ts, which already runs in chromium and webkit-settings. The Settings test covers enabled switch off/on, native select, selected/unselected segments and a retained textbox positive control in Paper/Ink at the existing 640x620 size. The Quick Settings test boots a controlled editor document, opens the actual panel, and checks its real bool/segmented consumers in Paper/Ink at 1440x900; it must not invent a select consumer because the panel has none. Use real Tab/Shift-Tab traversal from an observed non-target starting control. If WebKit requires Option-Tab, attempt ordinary Tab first and record the fallback; never replace reaching the target with focus() or DOM event dispatch. Count preference-transport calls and snapshot control value/checked state, selected/nearest-preset state and control/row bounding rectangles before focus. Require focus-visible, computed solid two-pixel prefAccent outline and one-pixel offset, unchanged value/event count/geometry, visible before/after row captures, and removal after Tab away. Verify pointer-only activation does not force a keyboard outline beyond the browser's focus-visible behavior, using a fresh pointer-first context. Existing component suites retain disabled/callback coverage. Inspect screenshots for ring clipping/overlap; CSS assertions alone do not prove painted visibility. Preserve the four original textbox-positive observations and earlier failures as history.
